The throwing guard is `assertCan` in `src/lib/permissions.ts`. It returns `void` and throws `PermissionDeniedError` when `explain()` denies the action, while `can()` is the boolean variant.

Fourteen source files call it, 51 call sites in total. All are service-layer files under `src/server/services/`. The action layer and components don't call it directly. I excluded the two test files that call it (`tests/contract/permissions.test.ts` and `tests/lib/permissions.ownership.test.ts`) because they aren't source files. I also excluded comment mentions in `src/actions/_lib/action-errors.ts`, `src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx`, and `src/components/domain/permission/permission-gate.tsx`, plus the string entries in `scripts/manifest-parts/server.ts` and `corpus-manifest.json`. If you want the test files counted, add them to the list.
